newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Aug property deals down in number on month.
newsitem.headline: HK Aug property deals down in number on month.

text.p: The number of sales and purchase agreements for residential and non-residential properties in Hong Kong fell by 21.5 percent in August versus the previous month, said the Land Registry on Tuesday.
A total of 9,972 transactions were lodged in August, down 21.5 percent from July, but up 47.5 percent against July 1995, it said in a statement.
The total consideration of the transactions was HK$29.5 billion, down 30.1 percent and up 59.1 percent respectively from July 1996 and August 1995, it said.
